Role: Service Delivery Manager

Department: Managed Services

Visa Sponsorship: You must have legal working rights in the country of your residence within the European region. Sponsorship is only available within the Netherlands.

What is your goal? As a Service Delivery Manager, you are accountable for delivering high-quality managed services to international customers. You oversee complex service environments across Dynamics 365, Azure, integrations, and data, ensuring operational stability, customer satisfaction and continuous improvement.

**Leading Microsoft Partner

**HSO belongs to the elite Microsoft Dynamics Inner Circle for 21 years, within the top 1% of all Microsoft partners worldwide. With over 2,800 professionals, and a worldwide presence, we deliver successful implementations across industries globally.

**HSO International

**At HSO International, you’ll join a diverse team of 300+ colleagues from 50+ nationalities, working on cross-border projects that make a global impact.

Learn more about Life at HSO International: https://www.hso.com/en/campaigns/life-at-hso-international/

**Responsibilities

**

• Own end-to-end service delivery across Dynamics 365 F&O, CE, Azure, integrations, and data solutions.

• Build trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders and align services with their business objectives.

• Lead and coach the DevOps customer support team.

• Own SLAs, service performance, budgets, escalations, and continuous improvement.

• Lead Release & Change Management, including release governance, CAB processes, risk assessment and production deployments.

• Coordinate releases and resolve dependencies across functional and technical teams.

• Identify opportunities to improve and expand customer services.

• Contribute to service delivery standards and best practices within Managed Services.

**When Are We a Match?

****You Have

**

• A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, IT, or a related field.

• At least 10 years of relevant professional experience, including substantial experience within Microsoft Dynamics 365 and enterprise managed services.

• Senior-level Service Delivery Management experience in complex customer environments.

• Proven ownership of multiple services across Dynamics 365 F&O, CE, Azure, integrations, and data.

• Proven Release & Change Management experience, including release governance, CAB processes, and production deployment ownership.

• Experience managing SLAs, budgets, service quality, customer satisfaction, and escalations.

• Strong knowledge of Microsoft cloud solutions and modern service management practices.

• Experience working with international customers and distributed delivery teams.

• Commercial awareness and the ability to support service growth opportunities.

• Fluency in English.

**Strong Advantages

**

• Experience transitioning projects into managed service operations.

• Experience with Dynamics 365 One Version Management.

• ITIL certification or experience working for a Microsoft Partner.

**You Are

**

• Accountable and customer-focused.

• Able to oversee complex services involving multiple technologies and stakeholders.

• Calm and decisive when managing escalations and production risks.

• A strong communicator who can translate complex topics into clear decisions and actions.

• Collaborative, proactive, quality-minded and commercially aware.

**Why should you choose HSO International?

****Development and growth

**You get a job with plenty of career opportunities with a leading provider of innovative enterprise business solutions and distinct Microsoft Global Solution Integrator, who perceives your motivations, talents and ambitions.

**Fun and success

**You work in a collaborative and professional environment where success is built on teamwork and with colleagues who are ready to help each other.

**International project exposure

**Joining our team offers an exciting opportunity to engage in international projects, providing invaluable exposure to diverse cultures, markets, and perspectives. Through your involvement in these projects, you will broaden your global network, enhance your cross-cultural communication skills, and gain firsthand experience in navigating the complexities of international collaboration.

**Freedom and responsibility

**You have the freedom and flexibility to organize your workdays, but especially to shape your own career.

**Take the next step!

**Does the combination of business processes and Microsoft technology appeal to you? Take the next step in your career path with HSO International!

jobs.occupation: Project lead (strain engineering for client delivery)
jobs.description:
Enduro Genetics is a world-leading biotech at the interface of synthetic biology and biomanufacturing. Our platform product Enduro Sense is a transformative gene technology that redefines the capabilities of cells in fermentation. Enduro Sense is used for cell-based expression systems and production strains to deliver higher titer, rate and yields, making biomanufacturing more efficient and scalable.

As we expand to meet growing client demands, we are seeking a results-driven and people-oriented Project Lead to oversee our microbial strain engineering projects with clients.

Who You Are:

This role is perfect for a senior science leader passionate about leveraging synthetic biology to create tangible biomanfacturing step-ups for clients while fostering team growth and motivation. You thrive in fast-paced settings, communicate clearly and are eager to join a rapidly scaling company, currently around 25 employees.

Responsibilities:

• Lead and mentor high-performing R&D teams to drive project success.

• Develop and implement research strategies to meet key milestones.

• Oversee client projects to ensure timely progress and impactful results.

• Collaborate with scientists and stakeholders of all levels to deliver on project timelines and deliverables.

• Provide expert technical guidance to support project outcomes.

What You Bring:

• Education: PhD in Synthetic Biology, Molecular Biology, or a related discipline.

• Industry Experience: 7+ years in microbial strain engineering, with corporate expertise in pharmaceutical or industrial bioprocesses.

• Technical Expertise:

• Strong background in production strain technology, recombinant protein expression, or metabolite production.

• Proven track-record in developing microbial strains for bioprocesses.

• Leadership: Exceptional project management skills, including team mentorship and development.

• Analytical and Communication: Ability to solve complex problems and communicate effectively incl. in written and oral presentations.

• Adaptability: Capacity to excel in a dynamic, fast-growing organization.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience leading agile R&D teams.

• Technical strain engineering experience in Bacillus, E. coli, Corynebacterium or yeasts (Pichia, S. cerevisiae etc)

• Familiarity with corporate bioprocess development workflows.

• Knowledge of Design of Experiments (DoE), small-scale automation, and fermentation science.

• Background in pharmaceutical GMP environments.

• Relevant experience from e.g. a CDMO or CRO on delivering projects with clients or collaboration partners

Why Join Enduro Genetics?

At Enduro, you'll play a vital role roling out our technology to leading clients, shaping the future of biomanufacturing. Be part of a collaborative and innovative environment where your contributions make a difference.

If you're ready to advance your career in industrial biotechnology and lead impactful projects, apply now to join our team.

Applications will be screened regularly

Business Director at JSS Search, specialising in Senior & Executive Finance recruitment across London’s Technology, SaaS and Data Markets

We are partnering exclusively with our Private Equity client as they build out their new Commercial Finance capability to support the next phase of growth. This is highly commercial leadership role, embedded within the business and partnering directly with senior operational and commercial stakeholders - rather than sitting within a traditional reporting function, you'll operate at the heart of decision-making, helping leadership teams navigate growth, complexity and change while shaping how commercial performance is understood and managed across the organisation.

As Commercial Finance Director, you will act as the senior commercial sparring partner to your leadership team, turning financial and operational data into clear insights that drive action. You'll identify the key drivers behind performance, challenge assumptions, evaluate strategic opportunities and ensure investment, pricing and resource decisions are grounded in sound commercial thinking. Working closely with business leaders, you'll build robust business cases, highlight risks and opportunities before they emerge in reported results, and create greater accountability around performance. Success in the role will come from your ability to influence senior stakeholders, balance commercial judgement with analytical rigour, and provide the constructive challenge needed to improve outcomes.

About You

• Experience in Commercial Finance, Strategy, Consulting, Sales Operations or a similarly commercial and analytical environment ideally within the Technology/SaaS industry.

• Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and shape business decisions.

• Strong commercial acumen with a genuine interest in understanding business performance and growth drivers.

• Comfortable moving between strategic thinking and hands-on analysis.

• Experience partnering with senior operational or commercial leaders.

• Confidence to challenge assumptions, push back where necessary and provide an independent viewpoint.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to present complex issues clearly and concisely.

• Experience in technology, software, recurring revenue, subscription or other data-led business models would be advantageous.

• Finance or accounting qualifications are welcomed but not essential.

• A naturally curious, proactive and commercially minded approach.

• Experience operating within a Private Equity backed environment would be beneficial

This role will operate as a hybrid engagement with circa 2-3 days onsite in the Copenhagen office - representing an excellent opportunity to network and build relationships with key stakeholders with the organisation. There may be occasional travel required within Europe, but this will be limited and only to meet business needs - expect to be largely based in Copenhagen.

To hear more please apply directly.

At Securitas Technology, we're looking for a commercially driven General Manager to lead our Danish business through its next phase of growth, transformation and market expansion.

We're seeking a leader who thrives on building momentum, creating commercial focus and delivering results. Someone who can see the potential in a business, bring people together behind a shared vision and turn strategy into performance.

With full responsibility for the Danish operation, you'll lead the business owning everything from commercial growth and customer relationships to operational excellence, people leadership and P&L performance. You'll also play a pivotal role in bringing together our Technology and CamVision businesses, helping shape a stronger, more integrated organisation for the future

Why This Opportunity?

This is a rare chance to step into a country leadership role where your impact will be visible from day one.

You'll inherit a business with strong operational foundations and talented people already in place. The opportunity now is to strengthen commercial performance, build greater accountability, accelerate growth and establish Denmark as a leading performer within Northern Europe.

If you're energised by transformation, growth and creating lasting business success, we'd like to hear from you.

What You'll Be Responsible For

• Full country P&L ownership.

• Driving revenue growth, profitability and market share.

• Leading and developing commercial and operational teams.

• Building stronger sales capability and commercial discipline.

• Strengthening key customer relationships.

• Leading the continued integration of CamVision.

• Creating alignment, accountability and business performance across the Danish organisation.

What We're Looking For

You'll be an accomplished business leader who combines strong commercial instincts with operational credibility.

Your background will likely include:

• Experience as a General Manager, Managing Director, Country Manager or Business Unit Director.

• Ownership of a significant P&L with responsibility for business performance.

• A proven track record of driving revenue growth and leading commercial teams.

• Experience leading service-led, installation, project-based or field operations businesses.

• Success in improving business performance within a changing or challenging environment.

• The ability to engage, motivate and develop diverse teams.

• Experience operating within a regional, international or matrix organisation.

Sector Experience We Value

We're particularly interested in leaders from:

• Security Integration

• Electronic Security

• Fire & Security

• Smart Buildings

• Building Technologies

• Technical Services

• Engineering Services

• Other project and service-led technology environments

Why Securitas Technology?

At Securitas Technology, you'll join a global leader with a clear purpose: helping make the world a safer place.

This role offers the opportunity to:

• Shape the future of our Danish business.

• Lead with real autonomy and influence.

• Drive a high-profile business integration programme.

• Contribute to the wider Northern Europe leadership agenda.

• Build a lasting legacy within one of the world's most recognised security and technology brands.

Before You Apply

This opportunity is best suited to leaders who combine commercial leadership, P&L ownership and operational management experience.

Ready to make a lasting impact? We'd love to hear from you.

jobs.occupation: Fulfilment Operations Coordinator, Full Serve, 37 hours per week, Gentofte
jobs.description:
WHO YOU ARE

Are you ready to join us in ensuring our customers receive the best experience with timely and accurate order fulfilment?

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Fulfilment Operations Coordinator to join our Logistics Team. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the efficient and timely picking of Click & Collect and Cash & Carry orders, contributing to a seamless customer experience. Your primary goal is to coordinate order

fulfillment processes, ensuring accuracy, speed, and quality service.

To be successful in this job, you:

• Must have experience in Logistics, Order fulfilment or Warehouse operations

• Have strong organizational and problem-solving skills

• Are able to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment

• Have excellent communication and teamwork abilities

• Have attention to detail and a commitment to quality

Basic knowledge of inventory managements systems is a plus.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

• Conduct daily operational planning, provide an overview, delegate tasks based on priorities, and collaborate with team members to optimize workflow and productivity.

• Oversee and support the team, as well as perform tasks within the main areas of responsibility, including picking and packing goods and orders for Click & Collect and Cash & Carry, all within the agreed time with a focus on the customer.

• Work closely with the Replenishment Team for morning handovers and prepare for evening replenishment.

• Maintain a clean, organized, and safe environment throughout the fulfillment unit. Ensure adherence and compliance with all safety requirements by performing weekly safety checks and more.

• Monitor inventory levels, communicate any shortages or issues, follow up on empty locations to ensure inventory accuracy, and process all returns.

• Follow up on the heatmap and move goods to optimize business operations.

• Ensure a smooth daily handover to team leaders and support them in various tasks and projects as they arise.

OUR TEAM WITHIN IKEA

Here you will become part of our international team of both full-time and part-time employees working towards a common goal. We ensure efficient logistics in the store and provide excellent customer service, even without direct customer contact. You'll gain experience collaborating with various departments and diverse individuals. Join our fantastic logistics team, where we strive daily for a development-focused and well-being environment for our many colleagues.

QUESTIONS AND SUPPORT? LET'S CONNECT!

If you have job specific questions please contact Sara Unger, Fulfilment Operations Team Leader, sara.unger@ingka.ikea.com.

Please note that we only receive applications via our recruitment system and not via e-mail

Further information

• This position is for an average of 37 hours per week.

• Your working time will vary based on the business need, with both morning and evening shifts within the hours 06:00-20:30. You should also expect to work every 2nd weekend, both Saturday and Sunday. It is possible to give your input to the work schedule.

• Salary is within IKEA's banding and HK's Union agreement for logistics and includes free choice allowance, odd-hour payment and pension.

• Start date is as early as possible.

• Apply latest 15th of November 2026

• We have an ongoing interview process and reserve the right to close the job when we have received enough qualified candidates.

Like homes, talent is also diverse, and in IKEA we have a passion for real people. When applying for jobs, some are discouraged if they do not meet every single competence area, but please feel free to still apply. We would love to get to know you as there is a wide range of opportunities in IKEA, based on desire, ability, and experience. We hope you will join us on this adventure and we are looking forward to hearing from you!

Help build a medtech company's commercial engine – from the ground up

At Cebreo Medical we have spent more than 15 years turning ear-EEG research into NeuroBuds™: a small, discreet, CE-marked EEG device that records brain activity for weeks at home rather than for a single night in a lab. We are now taking it to market in sleep and epilepsy, both in clinical trials with pharma, biotech and CROs and in clinical use.

Our commercial team is small, and the foundation is still being built. We are looking for a young talent who wants to roll up their sleeves and help build it, working side by side with our CCO.

What you will do

This is a hands-on role. Your days will be about getting things done and moving things forward in the market, not about internal processes.

• Find and prepare customers: research which biotechs and CROs are running relevant studies and who makes the decisions, and build target lists our sales team can act on

• Equip sales: turn our value propositions into sharp customer materials, proposals and tender responses for epilepsy, sleep and pharma/biotech

• Keep the engine running: CRM discipline, pipeline follow-up and a simple monthly KPI and forecast rhythm

• Know the market: track competitors, key opinion leaders and market developments, and turn them into concrete actions

• Support market access: help the CCO with evidence and value materials and payer analyses

• Make our voice heard: LinkedIn, website updates and congress activities

• Drive initiatives across teams: work with Clinical Operations, Data Science, Scientific Affairs and R&D to get things delivered

As we grow, the role grows with you. You will have the chance to take ownership of a commercial area where your interests and our needs meet.

Who you are

• A doer. You prefer delivering to planning, finish what you start and are happy to take the next step without waiting to be asked

• Curious about AI. You already use AI tools to work faster and smarter in research, analysis and content, and you are curious about how AI can help a lean team punch above its weight

• Structured and analytical, with high-quality output and an eye for what really matters

• Brings energy to a team, has a low ego and is good at bringing people together across functions

• M.Sc. in business, economics, engineering, life science or similar

• 1–4 years of experience from commercial, strategy or consulting roles; medtech or life science is a plus

• Fluent English; Danish is an advantage

What we offer

• A rare chance to help build a commercial organisation from scratch, with real responsibility from day one

• An informal start-up culture – in a solid setting, backed by strong ownership and good working conditions

• Close collaboration with and sparring from an experienced CCO

• Technology with a unique story, strong science and a big market potential

• Competitive salary and pension

Start and application

• Start: As soon as possible

• How to apply: Apply with your CV via LinkedIn – no cover letter needed, just answer the short screening questions. Shortlisted candidates will get a short practical task (max. 1 hour) before the first interview. We review applications continuously and may close the posting early, so don't wait.

**HR Business Partner - International Role

**Experienced HR professional with an international mindset?

We are looking for an experienced and trusted HR Business Partner who enjoys working close to managers, employees and colleagues at our headquarters in Pårup.

This is an international role in which you will support selected business areas across countries and cultures throughout the employee journey. You will advise managers on organisational development, employee relations, recruitment, employment conditions and day-to-day leadership matters. You will also be responsible for coordinating and developing MASCOT's trainee programmes.

You will join an experienced HR team and report to the HR Manager.

Your key responsibilities

• Advise and support managers on leadership, employee relations and organisational development

• Manage recruitment processes from job profile to final employment

• Handle employee cases, including absence, difficult conversations, terminations and exit interviews

• Ensure compliance with employment legislation, contracts, policies and local employment conditions

• Plan and quality-assure onboarding activities

• Support international HR projects, employee surveys, workshops and annual HR activities

• Coordinate trainee recruitment, training plans and ongoing development

• Collaborate with managers and colleagues across MASCOT's international organisation

What you bring

You have at least five years of experience as an HR Business Partner or HR Consultant. You are confident in advising managers and comfortable handling both operational HR matters and broader organisational topics in an international business environment.

You are structured, responsible and able to move tasks from initiation to completion. You communicate clearly, listen carefully and build trusted relationships across functions, countries and cultures. You use your business understanding to combine sound judgement with a practical and solution-oriented approach.

Experience with recruitment, employment law, coaching, conflict management and HR systems is important. Knowledge of SAP SuccessFactors and LinkedIn Recruiter is an advantage.

You are fluent in written and spoken English. Fluency in another European language would be a strong advantage.

What we offer

At MASCOT, you become part of a family-owned international company with strong values, ambitious goals and short decision-making paths.

• An international HR role based at our headquarters in Pårup

• A permanent onsite position with close collaboration across the organisation

• A professional and supportive HR team

• Pension, health insurance and wellbeing initiatives

• Excellent food in our staff restaurant

• Employee discounts on MASCOT workwear

Ready to make a difference?

Apply today. We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

At MASCOT, we are united by passion, collaboration and the ambition to develop, manufacture and deliver the world's best workwear and safety footwear.

**Role and impact

**How do you help a new catalyst product move from development towards production? In this role, you’ll work at the practical heart of scale-up: designing, building and commissioning a catalyst production pilot line, then using it to run tests, develop process knowledge and deliver new capable products to our production plants. Your work will also support production teams with troubleshooting and help plant engineering make informed equipment decisions.

**Responsibilities

**Your primary objective will be to deliver capable new catalyst products, supported by well-established and understood process windows, to the industrialization step—the next stage in our new product development stage-gate model.

You will plan and carry out work safely, optimize equipment and processes, report your findings, and document relevant best practices. You will also work with production and engineering colleagues to address equipment and process needs.

**This Will Involve

**

• Designing, building and commissioning equipment for a catalyst production pilot line.

• Performing tests at the Manufacturing Development Centre, including completing safety assessments and reporting results.

• Troubleshooting production challenges and supporting problem-solving as a subject-matter expert in relevant unit operations and equipment.

• Assisting plant engineering and EPCM with equipment selection, testing (on site or at vendors) and reviews.

**What You Will Bring

**

• Equipment and/or unit operation subject matter expert in e.g. powder handling, milling, screening, continuous furnaces etc.

• Experience in Plant process engineering and commissioning experience

• Minimum 7 -10 years of relevant experience

• Experience troubleshooting and solving problems in industrial production processes.

• A practical, hands-on approach and confidence working directly with equipment.

• The ability to write clear, scientifically sound reports in English and communicate fluently in English, both spoken and written.

• Flexibility to manage changing priorities and work to tight timelines.

• Ability to work with several tasks and projects simultaneously, being robust/resilient when faced with challenges

**It Would Also Be An Advantage To Have

**

• Experience with production process scale-up or scale-down.

• Danish, both written and spoken or with a willingness to learn the language

• Project management experience.

• Knowledge of risk assessment, data handling or statistics

• Ability to think strategically and proactively seek information with respect to what is needed for future pilot development, Project manager experience, knowledge on risk assessment.

• Knowledge on data handling and statistics an advantage

**Why join us

**You’ll have the opportunity to be a part of accelerating new catalyst products to the market by building and operating a pilot facility, take part in practical testing, optimizing, and solve real equipment and production challenges. The role brings together design, hands-on problem-solving and technical reporting, with work that supports scale-up and manufacturing development.

**Your new Team

**You’ll join R&D’s Scale-up and Manufacturing Development team. You’ll work with colleagues involved in developing and industrializing new catalyst products, pilot testing, production troubleshooting and plant engineering support. The team’s work connects equipment and process development with the needs of industrial production.

**How You Can Apply

**If you would like to be part of a team of skilled and professional colleagues in an informal organization, please submit your documents in English.

**Application deadline: 23-11-2026.

**If you have questions regarding the role, feel free to reach out to Ninna Halberg Jokil, Director- Scale up and Manufacturing development, on NIH@topsoe.com.

You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application – just include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are applying. Please also avoid the use of photos in your CV. Both these measures are to ensure a fair and unbiased process.

We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, irrespective of their gender, age, religion, disability, ethnic background, and geographical location. We encourage individuals from diverse cultures and countries to apply and contribute to our global team.

To ensure a secure and trustworthy work environment, our recruitment process may include background checks, requests for criminal records, and contact with references.

To headhunters: Thank you for your interest in our company. However, we would like to inform you that we have a dedicated internal team managing our recruitment process. We kindly request that you refrain from reaching out to us regarding potential candidates. Thank you for your understanding.

**About Us

**Topsoe is a leading global provider of advanced technology and solutions for the energy transition.

Built on decades of scientific research and innovation, we are working with customers and partners to drive energy resiliency and to achieve their sustainability goals.

We offer world-leading solutions for transforming renewable resources into fuels and chemicals, and we provide technologies needed to produce low-carbon and conventional fuels and chemicals as well as ensuring clean air.

We were founded in 1940 and are headquartered in Denmark, with around 2,500 employees serving customers all around the globe. To learn more, visit www.topsoe.com.

At Topsoe we strive towards having a safe work environment. We are aware of the risks in our work and continuously optimize our safety procedures.

**Company Description

****Join Oterra in making natural food and beverages easy, for a sustainable and healthy world.

**_Headquartered in Denmark, with production sites in Europe, Latin America, and the US, we’re a passionate team of over 1200 team members of 48 nationalities in 27 countries worldwide, serving 120 markets globally. As the leading worldwide provider of natural colors, we offer food and beverage manufacturers an alternative to artificial colors. Food and health are at the heart of everything we do and every day over 400 million people eat a product with our colors in it. We believe that nature got it right the first time.

_**Job Description

**We are looking for an experienced Group Financial Controller with interest and experience in driving continued improvements to our financial reporting process to join us at our global headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark.

As Group Financial Controller, you will be part of the team responsible for ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant preparation of the Oterra Group's financial reporting. The group financial reporting is prepared in accordance with IFRS and the accounting principles applied under Oterra’s senior financing agreements.

You will report to the Head of Group Controlling & Reporting, but close collaboration with finance teams across the Group Finance, Group Tax, Group Treasury, Business Finance, and senior management is expected to ensure high-quality financial information is delivered to stakeholders.

In addition to supporting and controlling selected global sales and production subsidiaries, you will be part of developing and improving our group consolidation system, SAP Group Reporting, and related processes including data collection, intercompany eliminations, currency translation, ownership management and validation rules.

**Qualifications

**We imagine that you have a relevant master’s degree or alternatively, a diploma degree and bring at least eight years of relevant experience from similar roles within a global finance organization maybe combined with experience from consulting or auditing.

You have strong knowledge of IFRS and experience with consolidation systems (e.g., SAP Group Reporting, BPC, OneStream, HFM).

Just as importantly, you are able to communicate complex financial matters in a clear and pragmatic way. You combine strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail and enjoy working both independently and collaboratively across functions, cultures, and geographies.

We are looking to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible. Applications will therefore be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and interviews will be conducted continuously until we have found the right match.

Additional Information

At Oterra, we take care of our people – because when you’re supported, you can do your best work. Our

benefits are designed to support your health, your future and your life outside of work.

We are looking to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible. Applications will therefore be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and interviews will be conducted continuously until we have found the right match.

Activation at Sunrise TcTa is where business and brand strategy connect with content, creativity, media and tech. The team focuses on effectiveness — achieved through proven frameworks that align strategy and activation, driving measurable results for both Danish and international brands, mostly within the B2B sector.

We believe tactics without strategic understanding never lead to real impact… and the other way around.

Right now, we’re reshaping our setup to bring content, creative and media even closer to business and brand strategy.

About the position

We’re looking for a Paid Social Strategist to help set the direction for our paid media discipline within Activation together with the team and the management group.

You’ll bridge performance and media with strategy and creativity, ensuring that every campaign and initiatives delivers on marketing and sales KPIs as well as strategic objectives across brand, marketing and comms.

The role combines hands-on paid media management with strategic consultancy on LinkedIn and Meta.

It’s a plus if you also have experience with HubSpot and enjoy collaborating closely with our Content, Tech and Brand Strategy specialists.

Your tasks will include

• Plan, manage and optimise paid campaigns — primarily on LinkedIn and Meta.

• Translate business and brand strategies into actionable paid media plans that drive measurable results.

• Collaborate with Content, Tech and Brand Strategy specialists to ensure integrated execution.

• Advise clients on how paid, content and tech can strengthen marketing and sales effectiveness.

• Contribute to developing our paid frameworks and thought leadership within B2B activation.

• Work closely with the team on performance reporting and the use of HubSpot to connect paid activity to pipeline and revenue.

Your profile

• 3–5 years of experience in paid media strategy and execution, preferably within B2B marketing.

• Proven experience managing LinkedIn Campaign Manager and Meta Business Suite.

• A strategic mindset with strong analytical and creative understanding.

• Confidence in client dialogue — able to advise senior stakeholders.

• Interest in cross-disciplinary collaboration and working closely with other specialists.

• Experience with HubSpot is a plus.

About Sunrise TcTa

Sunrise TcTa isn’t a large conglomerate agency with standardised processes. We’re a privately-owned boutique agency based in Copenhagen. Independent and built to develop tailor-made strategic and creative solutions across industries, mostly B2B and often with an international footprint.

We’re a team of 30+ advisors, including brand and content strategists, creatives, designers, project managers and anthropologists.

Transitions are never easy.

But they’re often necessary.

Join us in working with the commercial ones.

Sunrise TcTa – Brand, Marketing & Commercial Strategy.

How to apply

If Sunrise sounds like the place for you, send your application and CV no later than 30 November 2026.

Please submit your application using the form below.

If you have any questions about the role, feel free to reach out to Jonathan Riis Gilmartin, Partner, Activation at jrg@sunrise.dk or by phone at +45 51 93 21 32.

**Our Purpose

**Planday from Xero is a leading digital solution that uncomplicates everyday scheduling and workforce management by making it easier for businesses and shift workers around the world to communicate, collaborate, and get work done.

Powered by a community of local industry experts, Planday provides a best-in-class digital platform that is easy to use, accurate, secure, and compliant with local needs and standards. From payroll and accounting to POS and reporting, its open API and tech ecosystem is scalable to fit shifting business needs and to build an engaged, flexible workforce.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark and supports over 400,000 users across Europe, Australia and the US. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

**How You’ll Make An Impact

**As our Lead Engineer- Data, you will set the architectural direction of the data platform that enables both the decisions we make internally and the data-driven features our customers rely on. Working with the Data, ML, Platform, and Product Engineering teams, you will keep ingestion, modelling, and orchestration dependable, and define the modelling, testing, and documentation standards the data function depends on. You will innovate on how people work with data, building the agentic tooling and semantic modelling that let teams across Planday work from trusted data with confidence.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Set the architectural direction of our data platform so it serves analytics, product engineering, and AI/ML from one coherent design, collaborating with Platform and ML engineering on shared infrastructure.

• Design the dbt models, semantic layer, and quality standards the data function depends on, with the validation and lineage to make them trustworthy downstream.

• Own orchestration and observability in Dagster, and onboarding new sources in a way that scales.

• Innovate on self-serve and AI-enabled analytics, from semantic models and agentic workflows to our BI layer.

Leading the commissioning strategy, team and schedule from mobilisation to integrated systems testing.

**Role Overview

**The Commissioning Manager leads Sensori's commissioning function on a project, ensuring mechanical and electrical systems are started, tested and proven safely, in the right sequence and to the client's acceptance criteria. The role develops the commissioning plan and schedule, manages commissioning engineers and vendor resources, controls the interface with the client's commissioning agent, and integrates commissioning requirements into the construction program so that handover is predictable and fully documented.

**Principal Duties And Responsibilities

**

• Develop and own the project commissioning plan, including strategy, organisation, level definitions, sequences, acceptance criteria and documentation requirements.

• Build and maintain the commissioning schedule; integrate it with the construction program and drive readiness of systems and areas to support it.

• Lead, allocate and develop the team of commissioning engineers; coordinate vendor and subcontractor commissioning resources.

• Chair commissioning coordination meetings with construction, quality, Authorised Persons, vendors and the client's commissioning agent.

• Oversee development and approval of method statements, checklists, test scripts and integrated systems test procedures.

• Manage the energisation and start-up sequence in conjunction with the Senior Authorised Person, ensuring permits, isolations and safety controls are in place.

About the Job

We are looking for a Senior Security Architect to shape and strengthen security across Stibo DX products, platforms, and cloud services. You will join a small, senior architecture team at the center of Stibo DX's transformation from self-hosted and hybrid deployments to a standardized, cloud-native SaaS platform.

This is a hands-on, embedded role. You will work with engineering, product, platform, operations, customer-facing teams, and legal to ensure security is built into our solutions by design, not added afterwards. You will turn security strategy and risk into practical architecture, reusable patterns, and controls that teams can implement.

Your goal is to establish a consistent security architecture across Stibo DX and give teams clear standards, patterns, and guardrails to make secure architecture decisions. Early priorities will include establishing a security architecture baseline, identifying key security gaps across our SaaS platform, strengthening security architecture reviews and threat modelling, and defining reusable security patterns for engineering teams.

The role is primarily focused on security architecture, product and platform security, and secure engineering practices. You will also drive the technical aspects of security governance and support compliance activities when needed, including security certifications, customer security requirements, regulatory obligations, risk assessments, policies, and audit preparation.

You will work alongside peer architects covering Software, Platform/Infrastructure, and Data/Integration, reporting to the Director of Solution Architecture. Our governance model is based on minimum necessary control: decisions close to teams, with oversight proportional to risk and impact.

Security remains a shared responsibility. The Senior Security Architect owns the security architecture direction, standards, patterns, and cross-cutting guidance, while Software, Platform/Infrastructure, and Data/Integration architects continue to consider and address security within their respective domains. Engineering teams remain responsible for implementing and operating the required controls.

What You'll Do

• Define security architecture strategy across Stibo DX products, platforms, and cloud services, including principles, standards, target architectures, guardrails, and roadmaps.

• Embed secure-by-design practices into product discovery, solution design, delivery, and operation, working with teams early rather than reviewing security only at the end.

• Lead security architecture reviews and threat modelling for product, platform, customer, and technology initiatives; identify risks and align on practical mitigation with accountable teams.

• Shape identity and access management covering authentication, authorization, federation, privileged access, service identities, secrets, and Zero Trust principles.

• Strengthen cloud and platform security for AWS, Kubernetes, networks, workloads, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, data, and shared SaaS platform capabilities.

• Define reusable security patterns and controls for APIs, integrations, multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, encryption, key management, logging, monitoring, vulnerability management, and secure configuration.

• Embed security in the software development lifecycle by defining practices and guardrails and helping teams integrate security into engineering practices, automation, architecture decision records, and delivery pipelines.

• Lead security governance and compliance work when needed including security policies, control design, risk assessments, evidence coordination, audit preparation, and remediation planning.

• Translate external requirements into technical action including customer security expectations, contractual commitments, privacy requirements, and relevant frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, and CRA.

• Raise security maturity across Stibo DX through coaching, practical guidance, cross-team collaboration, and clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What we're looking for

Experience

• 10+ years of experience across software engineering, cloud/platform engineering, or cybersecurity, with 4+ years in a senior security architecture or technical security leadership role.

• Proven experience designing and securing cloud-native, distributed, and microservices-based systems in production.

• Practical experience with SaaS and multi-tenant architectures, including tenant isolation, identity, data protection, and shared platform controls.

• Experience leading threat modelling, security architecture reviews, risk assessments, and remediation planning across multiple teams or product areas.

• Experience defining security standards, patterns, reference architectures, and governance that teams can apply in practice.

• Experience working with security and compliance frameworks and translating them into proportionate technical and organizational controls.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to influence engineers, architects, product leaders, operations, customers, legal, and senior stakeholders.

Technical expertise

• Cloud security, preferably AWS, and Kubernetes/container security.

• Identity and Access Management, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, federation, privileged access, and service identities.

• Application, API, integration, and event-driven security.

• Network security, workload protection, secrets management, encryption, certificates, and key management.

• Secure software development lifecycle, DevSecOps, infrastructure as code, CI/CD security, and software supply-chain security.

• Security logging, monitoring, detection capabilities, vulnerability management, and incident preparedness.

• Threat modelling, security risk analysis, Zero Trust, and defense-in-depth principles.

Nice to have

• Experience leading or materially supporting ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR security controls, CRA, or similar initiatives.

• Experience with enterprise customer security assessments, contractual security requirements, and audit evidence coordination.

• Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, SABSA, AWS Certified Security - Specialty, or equivalent practical experience.

• Experience helping an organization establish or mature a security architecture and governance capability.

Personal qualities

• Hands-on and credible with engineers, while able to communicate security clearly with product, customers, legal, and leadership.

• Pragmatic and risk-based: able to balance security, usability, operational complexity, cost, and delivery speed without compromising critical controls.

• Collaborative and influential, using expertise, evidence, and trust rather than creating unnecessary gates.

• Structured and decisive, able to make risks, responsibilities, and architectural decisions explicit.

• Curious, adaptable, and motivated by building long-term security maturity while helping teams deliver now.

What We Offer

• Real influence on the security foundations of Stibo DX's cloud-native SaaS transformation.

• Ownership of security architecture and a central role in shaping security governance and compliance maturity.

• Hands-on work on real product, platform, customer, and operational challenges, not security from an ivory tower.

• A small, senior architecture team with trust, autonomy, and meaningful responsibility.

• High visibility across product, engineering, operations, customer-facing teams, legal, and leadership.

• The opportunity to create reusable security practices and patterns with lasting impact across Stibo DX.

Interested?

Apply at your earliest convenience. Short-listed candidates will be invited for an interview. Applications are processed as they are received until the right candidate is found.

For any questions, please reach out to hiring manager Safdar Aqeel Safdar on safs@stibodx.com.

Take a leading role in delivering Maersk’s next generation of vessels!

You will combine naval architecture expertise with hands-on project management, steering complex newbuilding activities from early design and specification through construction and delivery.

Maersk is transforming its fleet through new technologies, new fuels and ambitious requirements for safety, efficiency and sustainability. You will join Fleet Technology in Copenhagen and work directly with shipyards, designers, classification societies, equipment makers, site teams and specialists across Maersk.

At Maersk, we believe in the power of diversity, collaboration and continuous learning, and we work hard to ensure that the people in our organisation reflect and understand the customers we exist to serve.

About the role

This is a project delivery role with a strong naval architecture foundation. You will lead and coordinate engineering work across disciplines, turn technical findings into clear recommendations and help mature key matters towards timely project decisions. Your judgement will influence vessels from the drawing board until they enter service.

What you will do

• Lead naval architecture and newbuilding project activities from concept development and specification through detailed design, construction and delivery.

• Plan, coordinate and follow up engineering activities, interfaces, risks and decisions across project teams, shipyards and site offices.

• Drive design reviews, plan approval topics, technical evaluations and trade-off studies with internal and external partners.

• Continuously challenge how we can make our vessels safer, smarter, more efficient and more sustainable.

• Translate technical analyses into clear recommendations that enable well-informed decisions.

• Act as a naval architecture subject matter expert while building alignment across disciplines and organisations.

• Contribute to major conversions, fleet optimisation and strategic technology initiatives alongside our newbuilding portfolio.

• Support and share knowledge with colleagues in a collaborative environment with flat team structures and a strong sense of shared ownership.

What we are looking for

• A degree in Naval Architecture and 5+ years of relevant experience in ship design, newbuilding or maritime engineering.

• Proven project management experience from ship newbuilding or major conversion projects, gained with a shipowner, shipyard, designer, consultancy or classification society.

• Experience taking engineering work from concept and specification into detailed design and execution.

• A solid understanding of vessel design, ideally including areas such as stability, structural, statutory or classification requirements.

• Experience with technical specifications, design reviews and/or plan approval.

• The ability to coordinate multidisciplinary work, manage technical risks and keep complex activities moving forward.

• Sound engineering judgement, a collaborative working style and clear written and spoken English.

It is an advantage if you also have

• Direct experience working with shipyards during newbuilding design and construction.

• Experience with design optimisation and technical trade-off studies balancing performance, cost and project constraints.

• Knowledge of container vessel hull structure, lashing and cargo systems, outfitting or accommodation design.

_As our new Test Manager, you will play a key role in delivering our SitaWare and Iris suites, an integrated, ultra-modern command-and-control toolset that helps Defence customers make critical decisions wherever they need it. You will apply your broad test and engineering skills in an agile environment with highly skilled colleagues, as part of our growing Defence Services team in Copenhagen.

**The job

As our new Test Manager, you will be involved in everything from the start of a feature, writing test cases and managing the process, through to verifying the final testing before we deliver the solution to our Defence customers.

• Planning and conducting acceptance tests (FAT and SAT) with customers, both at our own facilities and at customer sites

• Conducting integration tests with third-party software and hardware

• Challenging solution design against risks, based on system context, customer requirements and security

• Taking part in military exercises to support the use of our solutions and find new ways of testing that reflect real-life use

• Establishing and maintaining test environments, and contributing to tender and proposal work on test and test management approach

You should expect travel within the Nordics, and potentially elsewhere in Europe, several times a year.

**Joining the team

**You will join a small but growing team in a brand-new office in the heart of Copenhagen, working closely with your Nordic colleagues while also collaborating with other teams across our global constellations. Testing is an integral part of our development process, and you will be part of a wider community of testers and test managers, with knowledge-network events to exchange ideas, hear lectures, share best practice and get to know your colleagues. It is an agile, fast-moving environment with flexible, trust-based working hours and plenty of room for personal responsibility.

**Your Qualifications

**To succeed in this role, you bring:

• A technical degree, Bachelor's or Master's

• Solid experience as a Test Manager or in a similar role, with strong technical skills

• Experience with test management tools such as TestRail and Jira, including the Xray and R4J plugins

• Hands-on experience with test execution in close cooperation with stakeholders, and the ability to analyse and communicate technically complex solutions

• Solid knowledge of Windows and Linux environments, SQL/MS SQL Server, Active Directory, and networking fundamentals (IP, TCP, UDP, multicast, routing, firewalls), along with scripting skills in PowerShell or Bash

• Fluent Danish and English

• The ability to understand product requirements and translate these into effective tests

Alongside this, we value:

• Enjoys working in a changing environment, eager to step outside your comfort zone to make a difference

• Highly motivated to develop and apply your technical skills in a broad, technical role

• Enjoys customer-facing activities such as presentations, technical support, training and testing, building the trust that drives customer satisfaction

• Self-motivated and committed, with a hands-on approach

ISTQB or TMAP certification, automated testing experience, or experience with testing standards such as ISO/IEEE 29119, ISO 25010 or ISO 9001 are an advantage.

Experience with radio networking (e.g. VHF, HF) or tactical communications systems is a strong plus.

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

**Welcome to Systematic Copenhagen

**When you join us in Copenhagen, you're not just getting a desk at one of the city's best locations—you are stepping into a workplace where community matters. Our Employees Club keeps things lively with monthly social events, and our office catering makes sure you are always well taken care of. Whether you are into casual games or just good company, you will find both at our foosball table or during our relaxed Friday bar gatherings.

**Never stop developing

**Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. jobs.occupation: Data Center Facilities Technician II, Electrical
jobs.description:
**Minimum qualifications:

**

• Associate's degree, trade school certification, or other certified training in a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 2 years of electrical experience (e.g., electrical testing equipment or electrical distribution) in industrial or commercial environment.

• Ability to participate in material handling tasks such as lifting, carrying or moving up to 50 lbs (23 kg) of equipment, the required use of safety equipment such as limited weight bearing work platforms, ladders, step stools and personal protective equipment (PPE) like safety harnesses in accordance with safety and ergonomic guidelines and assessments.

• Ability to work non-standard hours and work rotations/shifts.

**Preferred qualifications:

**

• Experience in data centers, hospitals, or power plants.

• Experience in electrical maintenance in critical large scale facilities (Data Center, Pharma, Medical or Electrical) including UPS, generators, LV/MV switchgear Strong electrical safety awareness and ability to develop switching procedures and RAMS.

• Knowledge of electrical systems used in a data center environment (e.g., Feeders, Transformers, Generators, Switchgear, UPS systems, ATS/STS units, PDU/PMM units).

• Knowledge of meters, devices, sensors, and troubleshooting utilizing standard hand tools, digital metering, or calibration/diagnostic equipment.

• Ability to communicate with contractors who perform maintenance or upgrade work on the data center systems.

**About The Job

**The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical engineering, mechanical engineering and HVAC systems in the world. Facilities Technicians at Google data centers operate, monitor and support physical facilities conditions. Some of these duties will include heating and cooling of air and water, power supply, generators, UPS systems, electrical distribution and control and monitoring systems. You regularly help inspect, maintain and repair various data center systems such as piping and non-critical electrical or mechanical system components). You provide daily assistance to senior technicians as you read blueprints/schematics, conduct tours of systems and assess their working order.

As an advocate for best practices, you develop creative approaches to reducing operational costs while improving overall data center efficiency. You ensure that environmental and safety standards are consistently met, identifying problems and making repairs quickly. In emergency situations or abnormal conditions, you manage data center performance issues and outages to minimize the recovery time from failures.

As a Facilities Technician, you will operate, monitor, and support physical facilities conditions for our data centers.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Denmark: kr.600000 - kr.615000 (DKK) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

**Responsibilities

**Learn more about benefits at Google .

• Inspect, maintain, and repair various data center systems.

• Provide daily assistance to technicians as you read blueprints/schematics/sequence of operations, conduct tours of systems, and assess their working order.

• Manage the uptime and maintenance of UPS, generators, electrical distribution, and control and monitoring systems.

• Operate, monitor, maintain, and respond to abnormal conditions in the data center facilities systems and equipment.

• Support startup, commissioning, and integration of new electrical equipment and systems into facilities infrastructure.

Senior Global Leadership Development Manager

**People, leadership & performance

****Bagsvaerd, Denmark

**Are you passionate about leadership development and organisational growth? Do you have the skills to design and deliver impactful leadership initiatives on a global scale?

If you are ready to make a difference and collaborate with diverse stakeholders across the globe, we want you to join our team as a Senior Global Leadership Development Manager.

Read more and apply today!

Your new role

As a Senior Global Leadership Development Manager, you will :

• Deliver and execute leadership development priorities within assigned EVP/SVP areas or geographies through interventions for leadership teams and larger groups of leaders.

• Design and facilitate interventions using sparring, facilitation, coaching, and consultation to build leader capability in line with enterprise expectations.

• Act as the primary point of contact for designated EVP areas or geographies to support Lines of Business (LoB) and local People & Organisation (P&O) teams in developing and delivering contextualised leadership development solutions.

• Implement global processes, development offerings, and standards locally, adapting global content to local contexts while maintaining alignment with global leadership frameworks.

• Collaborate with HR Business Partners and business leaders to identify leadership capability gaps and co-create targeted interventions.

• Lead innovation in leadership development by identifying, piloting, and scaling new learning approaches.

Your new department

You will be part of Novo Nordisk’ Global Leadership & Learning Center of Excellence, joining the GlobalLeadership Execution team, which consists of 9 dedicated colleagues situated both in our HQ and in different locations around the world. Based in a dynamic and collaborative environment, our team works closely with global stakeholders to shape Novo Nordisk's leadership; equipping leaders at all levels to champion change, turn strategy into real results and build an engaging learning environment for all.

**Your Skills And Qualifications

**We are looking for a candidate with the following qualifications :

• A Master’s degree in business, HR, Psychology, or a similar field.

• +10 years of proven HR experience in two or more specialised HR functions (e.g., talent development, leadership development, learning & development, performance management, HRBP).

• Strong expertise in partnering with HR business partners and line leaders to design and implement solutions.

• Experience in leadership development and/or business HR consulting.

• Effective communication skills, including written, oral, and presentation skills.

• Strategic thinking, stakeholder influence, and relationship-building skills.

• Cultural intelligence and adaptability in a global and matrixed environment

**Nice To Have

**Experience from geographical areas other than your home country. - Knowledge of industry best practices and trends in learning science, talent strategy, and effective measurement of leadership development. - Leadership experience and experience leading organisational transformation work across stakeholder matrices. - Strong coaching skills, process facilitation skills, and practical experience working with team development. - Data-driven decision-making and evaluation skills.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 742,600 to 1,091,600 DKK.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Working at Novo Nordisk

Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with an unconventional spirit, a rare determination and a constant curiosity. For over 100 years this unordinary mindset has seen us build a company unlike any other. One where a collective passion for our purpose, mutual respect and a willingness to go beyond what we know delivers extraordinary results

**What We Offer

**There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.

More information
